note: User-editable routing defaults. Order matters: the first healthy agent wins; the rest are fallbacks when an agent is missing, unauthenticated, or out of quota (cooldown). Override per project with .swarmlord/routing.json in the repo, or per run with --agent. These are defaults, not facts — change them freely.

full_trust.note: Full-trust flags are NEVER passed by default. Set an agent to true here (or pass --full-trust per run) only inside a disposable container.
